svg.text: L / M / H / XH / Max denote effort; the legend lists scores; concentric markers indicate overlapping models. Hover SVG points for details.
Prices are the lowest quoted eligible non-promotional output rate, not the lowest total workload cost. Flex may have restrictions.
Input, cache-read, cache-write, tier overrides, quantization and exact provider are in the companion CSV. Missing rates are blank.
Some AA Claude scores use default fallback; the single-route price excludes fallback. Verify the sources and provider behavior.
Informational only, not for budgeting. Eurobotics provides no warranty; verify prices and suitability for your own use.
